title: SkillContract
description: SimFlow skill contract schema (SKILL.md frontmatter for built-in and project custom skills)

skill_name.description: Unique built-in SimFlow skill identifier or project custom skill entry point

stage_binding.description: Canonical workflow stage, custom activity label, domain tag, or list of such bindings. Custom labels are not automatically promoted to top-level stages.

agent_binding.description: Primary agent role for this skill

mcp_tools.description: MCP tools this skill depends on

required_mcp_tools.description: MCP tools that must be called when this skill is loaded. Used by the engagement contract (P0.7) to enforce skill-MCP hard-binding. At least one tool from this list must be called before state-write tools will be accepted.

minimum_mcp_engagement.description: Minimum number of MCP tool calls required when this skill is loaded. 0 means no MCP engagement required (documentation-only skill).

task_shapes.description: Task shape patterns that trigger this skill. Used by the task-shape-aware router (P3.4) to suggest MCP engagement for all task types, including single-stage compute tasks.
